studies.title: Radar
studies.caption: Robert Watson-Watt and Arnold Wilkins show that a bomber flying near Daventry reflects a BBC shortwave signal strongly enough to be detected.
studies.prompt: Oblique view inside an improvised field receiving setup near Daventry inFebruary1935: dark wooden radio receiver boxes, control knobs and a small cathode-ray tube showing a faint irregular linear trace, researcher in plain suit seen from behind leaning to inspect it. Through open shelter/van doorway, wire aerials on simple poles in a flat English field and a tiny distant biplane silhouette. Focus detecting a faint signal. NO rotating dish, green circular sweeping radar screen, modern monitor, digital readout, WWII fighter or giant futuristic antenna.
